general.title: General Assistant Prompts
prompts: Explain [topic] in simple terms, then give me 3 practical examples.
Help me think through [problem] step by step.
Summarize this text in bullet points: [paste text]
What are the pros and cons of [decision]?
Write a professional response to: [paste message]

coding.title: Coding Assistant Prompts
prompts:
Review this code and list specific improvements:
```
[paste code]
```
Write a [language] function that [describe task]. Include error handling and comments.
This error is occurring: [paste error]. Explain cause and fix.

Refactor this to be more readable:
```
[paste code]
```

Write unit tests for this function:
```
[paste code]
```

writing.title: Writing Assistant Prompts
prompts:
Improve clarity and flow of this paragraph:
[paste paragraph]
Write a [content type] about [topic] for [audience]. Tone: [professional/casual].

Make this more concise without losing information:
[paste text]
Generate 10 headline ideas for an article about [topic].

Proofread this and list all issues:
[paste text]

documents.title: Document Q&A Prompts
prompts: What are the 5 most important points in this document?
Find everything this document says about [topic].
Does this document mention any deadlines or dates?
Summarize section [X] in 3 sentences.
What action items does this document require?

agents.title: AI Agent Starter Tasks
prompts: Find the top 5 resources on [topic] and summarize each.
Write a Python script to [task] and run it.
Organize the files in [folder] by [criteria].
Create a [document type] based on: [description]
Research [topic] and write a one-page summary.

systemPromptTemplates.general: You are a helpful assistant. Be concise and accurate. If you don't know something, say so.
systemPromptTemplates.coding: You are an expert software engineer. Provide working, well-commented code. Suggest specific improvements with examples.
systemPromptTemplates.writing: You are a professional editor. Preserve the author's voice while improving clarity, flow, and impact.
systemPromptTemplates.documents: You are a document analyst. Extract information accurately. Flag ambiguity rather than guessing.
systemPromptTemplates.agents: You are an AI agent. Plan tasks step by step, execute them, and report results clearly.
